facts.q: Is there a thin black rod that runs from under the thigh down to the floor BEHIND the knee (on the buttocks side), rather than in front of the shin?
facts.when: the figure is in a sitting pose with thighs roughly horizontal (a chair is not required)

facts.q: How many thin black support rods reach from under the thighs down to the floor?
facts.when: the figure is in a sitting pose with thighs roughly horizontal (a chair is not required)

facts.q: Is there a round motor disc with a red gear on the outside of the knee joint?

must_not: a support rod or leg in front of the knee or shin
a support rod that ends in the air instead of on the floor
fidelity_clause: the device is worn ON the person's own legs; one carbon rear leg behind each thigh
